title: Simple Swords
description: This pack makes PvP Swords, Axes ( DIA AND NETH ) and other items simpler and smaller as well as highlighting cobwebs. It also comes with custom armour textures!
body:
![Pack Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/10c969b0c587502743e517e9890f9ff850707bc4_0.webp)

This pack makes PvP Swords and Axes ( DIA AND NETH ) and other items simpler and smaller as well as highlighting cobwebs! It also comes with custom armour textures!

The Shorter swords within the pack can provide a competitive advantage in PvP as well as the highlighted cobwebs making them much more visable!

As well as this the Pack makes both Tridents and Maces smaller to make PvP in these areas easier!
